meta.name: moe-training
meta.description: Train Mixture of Experts (MoE) models using DeepSpeed or HuggingFace. Use when training large-scale models with limited compute (5× cost reduction vs dense models), implementing sparse architectures like Mixtral 8x7B or DeepSeek-V3, or scaling model capacity without proportional compute increase. Covers MoE architectures, routing mechanisms, load balancing, expert parallelism, and inference optimization.

howto.what: Claude 会指导你使用 DeepSpeed 或 HuggingFace 训练混合专家模型（MoE），包括配置路由、负载均衡、专家并行等，给出代码示例和最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你询问如何训练 MoE 模型、实现稀疏架构（如 Mixtral 8x7B）或降低大模型计算成本时触发。

say.text: 我要用DeepSpeed训练MoE模型，怎么配置？

Claude 会展示 Mixtral 风格的路由代码。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you on training Mixture of Experts (MoE) models using DeepSpeed or HuggingFace, covering architecture, routing, load balancing, expert parallelism, and providing code examples and best practices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about training MoE models, implementing sparse architectures like Mixtral 8x7B or DeepSeek-V3, or reducing compute cost for large models.

say_en.text: How do I configure DeepSpeed for MoE training?
say_en.note: Claude will provide a DeepSpeed config example.

say_en.text: How to implement top-2 routing like Mixtral 8x7B?
